provenance.title: Windows and daylight
provenance.covers: How much window each room type usually has, and common window sizes. The daylight shares are common rules of thumb, not taken from the sources, which are about ventilation.

sources.name: Approved Document F: Ventilation (UK government). Listed as a place to check against. It was not opened.
